{{Quote|Candied H'nemthe yams 3.5 credits|The listing for the yams at Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''H'nemthe yams''' were a type of [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] that could be used in cooking. They were served candied as a side dish to be eaten with dinner in the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of the diner, enjoyed the dish and served portions of the yams for 3.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each,<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[H'nemthe/Legends|planet]] of the same name.<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
H'nemthe yams were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="DaD" /> On his blog, Walker stated that the yams were named as a reference to the character [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]], a H'nemthe who was nicknamed "yam nose" on the set of the film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
